extraction_limitations: Atoms were extracted by a language model and are marked needs_review; they have not been independently verified by a human reviewer.
Exact numeric values were not inferred from bar heights in Figures 5-7 when the paper did not report those values explicitly in text.

The LiteratureAtom schema is general-purpose and was originally illustrated with clinical-study contexts; for this AI/HTA methods paper, PopulationDescriptor, ExposureDescriptor, and OutcomeDescriptor are used to represent document corpora, evaluated methods/models, and evaluation endpoints for quantitative-result sufficiency.
No funding or conflict-of-interest atom was created because the accessible main text did not explicitly report such statements beyond acknowledgements and the generative-AI-use disclosure.
Related-work claims were excluded to focus the atom set on assertions about this primary study and its implementation, results, limitations, and stated future work.
